_comment: DSSSB TGT CS format: 200 questions, 2 hours. Add your actual questions below.
instructions: 200 questions | 2 hours | 1 mark each | No negative marking

questions.question: Which data structure follows the LIFO (Last In First Out) principle?
questions.explanation: Stack LIFO principle follow करता है — जो last में push हुआ वो first pop होता है। Queue FIFO (First In First Out) follow करता है।

questions.question: What is the full form of CPU?
questions.explanation: CPU का full form Central Processing Unit है। यह computer का brain कहलाता है।

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT an output device?
questions.explanation: Scanner एक input device है — यह physical documents को digital format में convert करता है। Monitor, Printer और Speakers output devices हैं।
